Inafanyaje kazi

Five steps from a guess to a measured system

Nothing here needs a phone in your hand. The controller holds the whole schedule locally and keeps running if the network drops.

01

Kuhisi udongo

Vichunguzi vya capacitive kwa milimita 150, 300 na 600 huripoti unyevu na joto kila dakika kumi na tano. Kidhibiti humwagilia eneo la mizizi, si uso.

02

Udhibiti unaozingatia hali ya hewa

Kidhibiti huvuta utabiri wa eneo. Ikiwa mvua ya milimita 8 inatarajiwa ndani ya saa kumi na mbili, mzunguko wa asubuhi hurukwa na kurekodiwa kama akiba.

03

Ugavi wa kanda

Mistari ya matone hupita kwa kanda kwa mazao na aina ya udongo. Kila kanda ina vali yake, mita ya mtiririko na ratiba, hivyo kitanda cha mchanga na cha udongo mzito haimwagiliwi sawa.

04

Ulinzi wa pampu na tanki

Vitambuzi vya kiwango huzuia pampu kukauka, na ufuatiliaji wa shinikizo huonyesha mstari uliopasuka ndani ya dakika badala ya mwisho wa siku.

05

Uthibitisho kwenye app

Lita zilizotumika, saa zilizookolewa, muda wa pampu na mavuno kwa kitanda huingia TRIXX Farm. Mwisho wa msimu unaweza kuona shamba liligharimu kiasi gani kuendesha.

Akiba iliyopimwa kwa mazao

Measured results across installed plots

These are averages from controllers we commissioned, not projections. Your soil type and pump capacity will move the numbers.

Crop Water Labour Payback
Nyanya kwa matone maji 42% pungufu saa 11 kwa wiki zimeokolewa miezi 14
Vitanda vya sukuma wiki na mchicha maji 34% pungufu saa 8 kwa wiki zimeokolewa miezi 11
Mahindi, yanayotegemea mvua na kuongeza maji 26% pungufu saa 6 kwa wiki zimeokolewa miezi 19
Bustani ya parachichi maji 38% pungufu saa 9 kwa wiki zimeokolewa miezi 16

Mfano halisi

Ekari moja ya sukuma wiki Kiambu, miezi kumi na miwili

A Family Plot installed on an existing one-acre kale operation in Kiambu. The controller and sensors were the only new hardware; the drip lines were already in place.

  • Maji yaliyotumika kabla1,140,000 litres
  • Maji yaliyotumika baada752,000 litres

  • Gharama ya maji baadaKES 188,000

  • Kazi ya umwagiliaji baada4 hrs/week

  • Malipo ya Shamba la Familia11 months

What we check before quoting

A controller cannot fix a pump that is too small.

  • ✓Pressure at the furthest emitter, measured, not assumed
  • ✓Pump flow rate against the number of zones you plan
  • ✓Water source: mains, borehole, tank or river, and its reliability
  • ✓Soil type at three depths, because sandy and clay beds differ
  • ✓Existing drip lines and their emitter spacing
  • ✓Power supply at the pump position, and whether solar is worth it
